$note: 夫妻宮（2026-10-12）：天機太陰.夫妻。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 夫妻宮 p.377–410。生離死別、再婚、外遇、配偶災病一類斷語不用；只按男女分嘅條文不用（引擎冇性別）。

rules.text: 天機太陰在夫妻宮，你們的關係容易受情緒左右，情緒太重時婚姻就會起波折。
rules.en: With Tian Ji and Tai Yin in your Partnership Palace, the relationship is easily swayed by mood, and when feelings run too high the marriage hits rough water.

rules.text: 天機太陰會天同化忌，你的伴侶容易過份敏感，婚姻較易起風波。
rules.en: Tian Ji–Tai Yin meets Tian Tong in Hindrance: your partner can be oversensitive, and the marriage more easily runs into storms.
